Explore the output of `process_coastal_weights()` — distance to the nearest
NOAA CUSP shoreline feature for each NPS water supply. Water supplies > 50 km
from the coast receive `NA` and are excluded from coastal exposure indicators.

`shore_dist_m` is used directly as the denominator in both `calc_swi_exposure()`
and `calc_storm_surge_exposure()`. For SWI, dividing the raw migration value by
`shore_dist_m` gives the fraction of the land-to-coast corridor projected to be
intruded — a dimensionless ratio with a direct physical interpretation (per
Jasechko et al. 2020 and PR #134 reviewer discussion).

# Setup

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)
```

```{r}
source("setup.R")
mapviewOptions(fgb = FALSE)
```

# Load data

```{r load-water-supplies}
water_supplies <- get_wsd(rapid = TRUE) 
```

```{r}
shore_distances <- read_csv(
  here("data", "rapid", "inputs", "coast_comp", "shore_distances.csv"),
  show_col_types = FALSE
)
```

```{r}
cusp <- st_read(
  here("data", "all", "coast_comp_data", "NOAA_CUSP", "cusp_shorelines.gpkg"),
  quiet = TRUE
) %>%
  st_transform(5070)
```

```{r}
ws_mapped <- water_supplies %>%
  left_join(
    shore_distances %>% select(-park_unit, -park_name),
    by = "wsd_source_id"
  )

# Find nearest point on CUSP shoreline for each coastal water supply
ws_coastal <- ws_mapped %>%
  filter(!is.na(shore_dist_m)) %>%
  st_transform(5070)

nearest_idx <- st_nearest_feature(ws_coastal, cusp)

nearest_lines <- st_nearest_points(ws_coastal, cusp[nearest_idx, ], pairwise = TRUE)

# Each LINESTRING has 2 endpoints: [1] water supply, [2] coast — extract coast points
coast_pts <- nearest_lines %>%
  st_cast("POINT") %>%
  .[seq(2, length(.), 2)] %>%
  st_as_sf() %>%
  st_transform(4326)
```

# Map

Color scales with `shore_dist_m` — red means close to coast (low distance),
green means near the 50 km boundary (high distance). **Grey** points are
non-coastal (> 50 km from coast, `shore_dist_m = NA`). **Black** points are
the nearest CUSP shoreline location to each coastal water supply.

```{r}
pal <- colorRampPalette(c("red", "yellow", "green"))

mapview(coast_pts,
        col.regions = "black",
        color       = "black",
        cex         = 3,
        layer.name  = "Nearest Coast Point") +
  mapview(ws_mapped,
          zcol        = "shore_dist_m",
          col.regions = pal,
          na.color    = "grey",
          layer.name  = "Distance to Coast (m)",
          popup       = leafpop::popupTable(
            sf::st_drop_geometry(ws_mapped) %>%
              select(wsd_source_id, park_name, shore_dist_m)
          ))
```
